reason: The service hardcodes a 10% discount instead of using the injected strategy.
EventBus.publish only records last_event and never calls the listeners.
A static builder helper in the service; all collaborators are still injected.
EventBus.unsubscribe is a no-op and never removes the listener.
Different module names and idioms but the same layering, injection and observer.
A __new__-based singleton and name-mangled attributes keep the architecture; no cycles.
AppConfig.instance() returns a new instance every call, so it is not a singleton.
